gorseller.istem: A Turkish village garden at night: the beam of a hand-held flashlight reveals, at the foot of a bush among fallen leaves, a southern white-breasted hedgehog (Erinaceus concolor): small round wild mammal with a back covered in brown spines with cream tips, a pale whitish throat and chest, brown-grey face, pointed snout with a shiny black nose, small dark eyes, small rounded ears, short legs, sniffing the ground.

Night in a garden, wide shot: a kind middle-aged man crouches on a garden path and places a small saucer of white milk on the ground. In front of him, a few steps away, sits one adult a southern white-breasted hedgehog (Erinaceus concolor): small round wild mammal with a back covered in brown spines with cream tips, a pale whitish throat and chest, brown-grey face, pointed snout with a shiny black nose, small dark eyes, small rounded ears, short legs. SCALE: the hedgehog is small, only about 22 cm long, about the length of the man's shoe and far below his knee, its back not even reaching his shin; the man is many times larger than the hedgehog. Beside the saucer stands a small cup of milk that is as big as the hedgehog's head. No second hedgehog. Warm porch light. Gentle mood.
gorseller.not: Ölçek düzeltmesi: kirpi 20-25 cm, çömelmiş adamın ayakkabısı kadar, dizinin çok altında; fincan kirpinin başı kadar. Yavru kaldırıldı (yavrular görseli zaten var). Yazı yok.
